title: Flawed withdrawal logic when caller differs from share owner
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Withdrawals in HyperEvmVault have a custom behavior. Users need to first call `requestRedeem()` to move funds from L1 back to the EVM side. After this, available funds to be withdrawn are stored in the `redeemRequests` mapping.  These mechanics lead to a specialization of the `previewWithdraw()` and `previewRedeem()` functions.
